turns.text: Shuka Uvacha Variyaneshate prashna kritoloka hitanrupa Atmavit sammatam shrotavyadi shuyah parah Shrotavyani harajendra nam santi sahasrashah Apashyatmatatvam gruheshu gruhamedhinam Nidraya kriyate naktam vyayenam vayam Divacharthe hayarajan kutumba bharanenava Dehapatya kalatradishvatma dainyeshva satvapi Teshuprakto nidhanam pashyannapi napashyati Tasmat bharata sarvatma bhagavan haririshvarah Shrotavyah kirtitavyashcha smartavyashchechata bhayam Etavan sankhya yogabhyam svadharma parinishtaya Janmalabha param samante narayana smritihi Prayena munayorajan nivrutta vidhinishedhatah Nairgunyastharamantesma gunanukathane hare Idam bhagavatam nama puranam brahma sammitam Adhitavan dvaparadau pitur dvaipayanadahm Parinishtitopi nairgunya uttamashloka lilaya Gruhita chetarajarsha akhyanam yadadhitavan Tadahante bhidhasyami mahapurushiko bhavan Yatra shraddhatamashusyan mukunde matis sati Etan nirvidyamananam ichatamakuto bhayam Yogina nrupannirnitam harer namanu kirtanam Kim pramattasya bahubhih parokshair hayaniriha Param muhurtam viditam ghatate shreyase yatah Khatvangonama rajarshijnatveyattamihayushah Muhurtat sangamutsrujya gatavanabhayam harim Tavapyetarhi kauravya saptaham jivitavadihi Upakalpayat sarvam yattavat samparayikam Antakale tu purusha agate gatasadhvasah Chindyadasanga shastrena spruhandeshenu yechatam Gruhat pravrajito dhirah punya tirtha jalaplutah Shuchau vivikta asino vidhivat kalpitasane Abhyasen manasa shuddham trivrud brahmaksharam param Mano yachchejjitashvaso brahma bijamanusmaran Niyachched vishayebhyokshan manasa buddhi sarathih Manah karmabhirakshiptam shubharthe dharayedhiya Tatraikavayavam dhyayedavyuchchhinnena chetasa Mano nirvishayam yuntvatat kinchinnasam smaret Padantat paramam vishnor mano yatra prasidati Rajastamobhyamakshiptam vimudham mana atmanah Yachched dharanaya dhirohantiyatat krutam malam Yasyam sandharyamanayam yogino bhakti lakshanah Ashu sampadyate yoga ashrayam bhadramikshatah Rajovacha Yatha sandharyate brahman dharanayatrasammata Yadrushiva haredashu purushasya manomalam Shri Shuk Uvacha Jitasano jitashvaso jitasangojitendriyah Stule bhagavato rupe manas sandharayedhiya Visheshastasya dehoyam sthavishthashcha sthaviyasam Yatredam drushyate vishvam bhutam bhavyam bhavat yat Andakoshe sharirasmin saptavarana samyute Virajah purusho yosau bhagavan dharanashrayah Patalametasya hi padamulam pathanti parshni prapaderasatalam Mahatalam vishvasrujas sugulbhautalatalam vai purushasya janghe Dve januni sutalam vishvamurterur dvayam vitalanchatalancha Mahitalantajaghanam mahipate nabhas talannabhisarogrunanti Urastalam jyotiranikasyagriva maharvadanam vai janosya Tapo raratim viduradipumsas satyantu shirshani sahasra shirshnah Indradayo bahava ahurasyakarnau dishah shrotramamushya shabdhah Nasatyadasrau paramasyanase ghrananja gandho mukhamagniriddhah Dyaurakshini chakshurabhut patangah pakshmani vishno sahani ubhecha Tadbhruvidrumbhah parameshthi dhishnyamaposyatalu rasayevajihva Chandamsyanantasyagirogrunantidam shtraryamenduduganadvijani Hasojanonmadakarichamayaduranta sargoyadapangamokshah Vridottaroshthodhara evalobho dharmastano dharmapathashcha prushthah Kastasyamedhrun vishanaucha mitrah kukshis samudragirayoshti sanghah Nadyosyanadyothatanuruhani mahiruha vishvatanor nrupendra Annancha viryam shvasitam matari shva gatirvayah karma guna pravahah Ishasyakeshan vidurambuvahan vasastu sandhye kuru varya bhumnah Avyaktamahur hrudayam manastu sachandrama sarva vikara koshah Vijnana shaktimmatimamananti sarvatmanontahkaranam giritrah Ashvashvatarayushthragajanakhanisarve mrugah pashavashronideshe Vachamsitadvyaharanam vichitram manurmanisha manujonivasah Gandharva vidyadhara charanapsarasvarasmrutirhyasuranika viryah Brahmanakshatra bhujo mahatma vidururanghrishrita krishna varnah Svaha svadha viryagunopapanno havyatmakah karmavitanayogah Yanasavishvara vigrahasya yas sanniveshah kathitoma yate Sandharyatesmin vapushishthavishthhe manasvabuddhya nayatostikinchit Shuka Uvacha Evam puradharanayatmayo nirnashtam smrutim pratyavaruhyatushyan Tatha sasrajedamogha drushtir yathapyayat pragvyavasaya buddhihi Shabdasya hebrahmanyesha panthayannama bhirdhyayati dhiraparthaih Paribhramam statra navindatirthan mayamaye vasanayashayanah Atah kavirnamasu yavadarthasyadapramatto vyavasaya buddhihi Siddhen yetharthenayate tatat tat parishramantatra samikshamanah Satyankshitau kinkashipoh prayasair bahau svasiddheshupabarhanaih kim Satyanjalau kim puruparna patrair digvastra labhe satikindukulaih Chirani kim pathina santidishanti bhikshanno vanghripah parabhrutas saritopyashushyan Ruddha guhah kimavadhuta sukhrunnakrushtah kasmat bhajanti kavayodhanadurmadandhan Evam svachittesvataeva siddha atma priyortho bhagavan anantah Tannirvruto niyatartho bhajeta samsara hetu paramashchayatra Sasarvavidrudyanubhushcha sarva atma yatha suptajanekshitai kah Tam satyamananda nidhim bhajeta sarvatmanatonyata atma ghatah Kastan tvanadrutya paranuchintamrute pashutvamasatinnamunjyat Pashyanjanam patitam vaitaranyam svakarmajan paritapanjushanam Kechit svadehantar hrudayavakashhe pradesha matram purusham vasantam Chaturbhujam kanjarathanga shankha gadadharandharanayasmaranti Prasanna vaktram nalinayatekshanam kadambakinjal kapishangavasasam Lasan mahahara hiranyamyaangadam sphuran maharatna kiritakundalam Unnidhra hrutpankaja karnikalaye yogeshvarasthapita pada pallavam Shri lakshanam kaustubha ratna kandharamamlanalakshmyavanamalayanchitam Vibhushitam mekhalayanguliyakair mahadhanair nupura kankanadibhih Snigdhamalaih kunchita nilakuntalair virochamanananahasapesalam Adina lila hasitekshanolla sadbhrubhanga samsuchita bhuryanugraham Ikshhetachintamayamenamishvaram yavan manodharanaya vatishthate Ekaikashongani dhyayanubhavayet padadi yavad dhasitangadabhrutah Jitanjitam sthanamapohya dharayet param param shuddhyati dhir yathayatha Yavannajayate paravaresmin vishveshvare drushtari bhakti yogah Tavaththaviyah purushasya rupam kriyavasane prayata smaret Sthiram sukhanchasanama sthito yadihyata jihasurimamangalokam Kalecha deshecha manonasajjyet prananiyachchen manasajit asuh Manashcha buddhya malayaniyamya kshetragnayetan ninayetamatmani Atmanam atmanyavaruddhya dhiro labdhopashantir virameta krutyat Nayatra kalo nimisha prabhuh prabhuh kutonudevajagatamyishire Nayatra satvannarajastamashchanavaivikaro namahan pradhanam Param padam vaishnavamamanantitadyannetinetyatyatadutsisrukshavah Visrujyadauratmyamananya sauhrudopaguhya puramumpade pade Ittham munistuparamedvyavasthito vijnanadrugvirya surandhitashayah Svaparshninapidya gudantatonilam sthaneshu shatsunnamayejjitaklamah Nabhyam sthitam hrudyavaropyatasmadudanagatyora sitannayen munih Tatonsandhayadhiya manasvi svatalamulam shanakairnayeta Tasmat bhruvorantaramunnayet niruddha saptashvapathona pekshah Thitva muhurtardhamakunthadrushtir nirbhidyamaurdhan visrujet parangatah Yadi prayasyat yathaparameshthyam vaihayasanamutadyadviharam Ashtadhipatyam guna sannivaye sahaivagachchen manasendriyashcha Yogeshvaranam gatimamananti bahistrilokyah pavanantar atma Nakarmabhistam gatimapnuvanti vidya tapoyoga samadhibhajam Vaishvanaram vyatihayasagatasushumnaya brahmapathenashochisha Vidhutakalkothaharerudastat prayati chakranrupashaimshumar am Yontah pachati bhutanam yastapatyandamadhya gah Sognirvaishvanaro margodevanam pitrunam mune Devayanam pingalabhyarahanyeti shatayusha Ratriridabhis pitrunam vishuvattam sushumnaya Tad vishvanabhintvabhipadya vishnoraniyasa virajenatmanaikam Namaskrutam brahma vidamupaiti kalpayusho yad vibudharamante Tho anantasyamukhanalenadandahyamana sanirikshya vishvam Niryati siddheshvara jushtadhishnyam yadvai parardhyantadu parameshthyam Nayatra shokona jaranamrutyurnadhyurnachodvegarute kutashchit Yashchittatodah kriyayanidam vidan duranta duhkha prabhavanudarshanat Tato vishesham pratipadya nirbhayastenatmanapo nalamurdhnichatvaran Jyotirmayovayumupetyakale vayuvatmanakham bruhadatmalimgam Ghranena gandham rasanena vairasam rupamtu drushtyashparshan tvachaiva Shrotrenachopetyanabhogunantat prayenanavruttimupaiti yogi Sabhuta sukshmendriya sannikarshat sanatanosau bhagavan anadihi Manomayam devamayam vikaryam samsadyamatya sahate nayati Vijnana tatvam guna sannirodhantena atmanamatmanamupaiti shantim Anandamanandamayo vasane sarvatmake brahmani vasudeve Etam gatim bhagavatogatoyas savai punarneha vishajjatenga Ete shrutite nrupavedagite tvayabhiprushtethasanatanecha Yedve purabrahmanaha prushta aradhito bhagavan vasudevah Nahyatonyashivah panthah vishrutasamsrutaviha Vasudeve bhagavati bhakti yogoyato bhavet Bhagavan brahma kartsnyenatriranvikshya manishaya Tad dhihyapashyat kutasthe ratiratmanyato bhavet Bhagavan sarva bhuteshu lakshitashchatmana harihi Drushyair buddhyadibhir drashta lakshanairanuma pakaih Tasmat sarvatmanarajan haris sarvatra sarvada Shrotavyah kirtitavyashcha smartavyo bhagavanrunam Pibantiye bhagavata atmanas satamrutam Shravanaputeshu sambrutam Punantite vishaya vidushitashayam vrajanti Tat charana saroru hantikam Shri Shuk Uvacha Evametan nigaditam prushtavan yad bhavan mama Runamyan mriyamananam manusheshu manishinam Brahma varchasakamastuyajeta brahmanaspatim Indramindriya kamastuprajakamah prajapatin Devim mayantu shrikamastejaskamo vibhavasum Vasukamo vasunrudran viryakamas tu viryadan Annadyakamastvatitim svargakamoditesutan Vishvan devan rashtra kamas sadhyamsam sadhako visham Ayushkamashvinau devau pushtikama ilam yajet Pratishtha kamah purushorodasi lokamatarau Rupabhikamogandharvan strikamopsara urvashim Adhipatya kamas sarvesham yajeta parameshthinam Yajnam yajedyashaskamah koshakamah prachetasam Vidyakamastugirisham dampatyartha umam satim Dharmarthamuttamashlokam tantum tanvan pitrunyajet Rakshakamah punyajanan ojas kamomarudganan Rajyakamo manundevan nirtintvabhicharan yajet Gramakamo yajet somamakamah purusham puman Akamah sarvakamova mokshakamodaradhihi Tivrenabhaktiyogenayajeta purusham param Etavanevayajatamihanihshreyasodayah Bhagavatya chalobhavo yadbhagavata sangatam Jnanam yada pratinivrutta gunorvimi chakramatma prasada ubhayatra guneshvasangah Kaivalya sambhruta pathastvatha bhakti yogah ko nirvruto harikatha suratinna kuryat Shaunaka Uvacha Ittyabhivyahrutam rajanishamya bharatarshabhah Kimanyat prushtavan bhuyo vaiyasakim rushim kavim Etachchushrushatam vidvan sutanorhasibhashitum Katha harigunodarasatam syusadasid dhruvam Savai bhagavato raja pandaveyo maharathah Balah kridanakaih kridan krishna kridamyadadhe Vaiyasakishcha bhagavan vasudeva parayanah Urugayagunodarasatam syurhisamagamem Ayurharati vaipumsamudyan nastanchayannasau Tasyartheyah kshanonita uttamashloka vartaya Taravah kinnajivanti bhastrah kinnashvasantyuta Nakhadanti namehanti kingrama pashavopare Shvavidvarahoshthakaraistulyah purushah pashuh Nayatkarnapathopeto jatu namagadagrajah Bilebatorukrama vikraman yena shrunvatah karnapute narasya Jihvasatidardurikevasutanachet pragayat turugaya gatham Bharasparam pattakiritajushtamapyuttamangannaname mukundam Shavaukarau nokurutas saparayyam harerlasat kanchana kankanauva Barahayitetena nayanenaranam lingani vishnornanirikshatoye Padau nrunantodrumajanmabhajau kshetrani nanuvrajatohare ryau Jivachchavobhagavatanghrirenunajatu martyobhilashetayastu Shri vishnupadyamanujastulasyashvasanchavoyastunavedagandham Tadashmasaram hrudayam vatedam yadgruhyamanair harinamadheyaih Navikriyeta thamukhe vikaro netre jalangatraruheshu harshah Athabhidehyangamanukulam prabhashase bhagavata pradhanah Yadahavaiyasakiratma vidya visharodonrupatim sadhu prushtah Suta Uvacha Vaiyasakeritivachastatvanishchay atmanah Upadharyamatim krishne auttareyas satim vyadhat Atmajayasutagara pashudravina bandhushu Rajyechavikale nitya nirudham mamatamjahau Paprachachemam evartham yanmam pruchatasattamah Krishnanubhava shravane shraddadhano mahayashah Samstham vijnaya sannyasya karmatraivargikanchyat Vasudeve bhagavati svatmabhavan drudhangatah Rajovacha Samichinam vacho brahman sarvajnasyatavanagha Tamovishiryate mahyam hareh kathayatah kathah Bhuyayeva vivitsami bhagavanatma mayaya Yathedam srujate vishvam durvibhaavyamadhishvaraih Yatha gopayati vibhuh yatha samyachchate punah Yam yam shaktimupashritya purushakshipta eva puman Atmanam kridayan kridan karoti vikaroti cha Nunam bhagavatobrahman hareradbhuta karmanah Durvibhaavyamivabhatikavibhishcha vicheshtitam Yatha gunastu prakruter yugapat kramashopiva Bibharti bhurishastvekah kurvan karmanijanmabhih Vichikitsitametanmebravitu bhagavan yatha Shabdabrahmani nishnatas parasminshcha bhavan khalu Suta Uvacha Ittyupamantrito rajna gunanukathane vibho Hrushikesha manusmrutyaprativaktum prachakrame Shri Shuk Uvacha Namah parasmai purushaya bhuyase sadudbhava sthana nirodha lilaya Gruhita shaktitrayayadehinam antardhruvayanupalabhya vartmane Bhuyo namas sadvrudinachchhidhesatam sambhavayakila satva murtaye Pumsam punah paramahamsya ashrame vyavasthitanamanumrugyadashushe Namo namaste stvashabhaya satvatam vidurakashtaya muhuh kuyoginam Nirastasamyatishayenaradhya svadhamanibrahmaniram syate namah Yat kirtanam yachchravanam yadikshanam yadvandanam yatsmaranam yadarhanam Lokasya sadyo vidhunoti kalmasham tasmai subhadra shravase namo namah Vichakshanayacharanopasadanat sangam vyudasyobhayatontaratmanah Vindantihi brahma gatimgataklamah tasmai subhadra shravase namo namah Tapasvinodanaparayashasvino manasvino mantra vidasu mangalah Kshemannavindanti vinayadarpanam tasmai subhadra shravase namo namah Kirata hunandhrapulinda pulkasah abhirakankayavanashakadayah Yenyecha papayadapashrayashrayachchhudhyanti tasmai prabhavishnave namah Sayeshatmatmavatamadhisvarastrayimayodharmamayastapomayah Gatavyalikairajashankaradibhirvitarkyalingo bhagavan prasidatam Shriyah patir yajnyapatir jagatpatirdhiyam patirlokapatirdharapatihi Patirgatishchandaka vrushni satvatam prasidatamme bhagavan satam patihi Yadanghribhidhyana samadhitautaya dhiyanupashyantihi tatvamatmanah Vadantiketatkavayo yatharucham same mukundo bhagavan prasidatam Prachoditayena purasarasvati vitanvatayasyasatim sthitim hrudi Svalakshana pradurbhutkilashyatasame rushinam rushabhah prasidatam Bhutairmahadbhirya imah puro vibhurnirmayashhete yadamushupurushah Bhunkte gunanchodashashodashatmakas solankrushishthabhagavan vachamsime Namastasmai bhagavate vasudevaya vedhase Papurjnanamayam saumyayanmukhamburuha savam Etadev atma bhurajan naradayeti pruchatate Vedagarbhobhyadhat sakshadyadaha hariratmanah Narada Uvacha Devadeva namaste stu bhutabhavana purvaja Tadvijanihi jnanam atmatatva nidarshanam Yadrupam yadadhishthanam yatsrushtamidam vibho Yatsamstham yatparam yachchatat tatvam vadatatvatah Sarvam hyetat bhavanveda bhutabhavya bhavat prabhuh Karamalaka dvishvam vijnanavasitam tava Yadvijnanoyadadharoyatparastvam yadatmakah Ekasrujasi bhutani bhutairevatma mayaya Atman bhavayase taninaparagbhavaye svayam Atma shaktimavashtabhya sutranabhirivaklamah Naham veda parantvasmannavaranasamam vibho Namarupa gunairbhavyam sadasatkinchitanyatah Sabhavanacharadghoram yat tapasusamahitah Tenakhedayasenastvam param shankanchayachchasi Etanme pruchatassarvam sarvajnasa kaleshvara Vijanihi yathaivedamaham buddhyanushasitah Brahmovacha Samyak karunikasyedam vatsate vichikitsitam Yadahan choditas saumya bhagavad virya darshane Nanrutam vata tachchapyatha mam prabravishibhoh Avijnaya parammatta etavatvam yatohime Yenasvarochishavishvam rochitam rochayamyaham Yatharkognir yathasomo yatharkshagrahatarakah Namastasmai bhagavate vasudevaya dhimahi Yanmayaya durjayayamam vadanti jagadgurum Vilajjamana yasyasthatumikshapathe muya Vimohitavikatante mamahamiti durdhiyah Dravyam karmachakalashcha svabhavojiva evacha Vasudevat parobrahman nachanyorthostitatvatah Narayana paraveda devanarayanangajah Narayana paraloka narayana paramakhah Narayana paroyogo narayana parantapah Narayana paramjnanam narayana paragatih Tasyapidrashturishasya kutasthasyakhilatmanah Srujyam srujami srushtohamikshayaivabhichoditah Satvam rajastama iti nirgunasya gunastrayah Sthitisarga nirodheshu gruhita mayaya vibho Karyakarana kartrutve dravya jnana kriyashrayah Badhanti nityadamuktam mayinam purusham gunah Saisha bhagavan lingaistribhiretairadhokshajah Svalakshita gatirbrahman sarvesham mamacheshvarah Kalam karmasvabhavancha mayesho mayaya svaya Atmanyadruchchaya praptam vibhubhushurupadade Kalatgunavyatikarat parinama svabhavatah Karmanojanma mahatah purushadhishthitadabhut Mahatastu vikurvanadrajassatvopabrumhitat Tamah pradhanastvabhavadravya jnana kriyatmakah Sohamkara itiproktovikuruvansamabhutridha Vaikarikastaijasashchatamasashchetiyadbhida Dravya shaktih kriya shaktirjnana shaktiritiprabho Tamasadapi bhutader vikurvanadabhunnabhah Tasya matra gunashabdo lingam yaddrushtrudrushyayoh Nabhosothavikurvanadabhuts parshagunonilah Paranvayachchhabdavashcha prano ojassaho balam Vayorapivikurvanat kala karmasvabhavatah Udapadyata tejo vai rupavat sparsha shabda vat Tejasastuvikurvanadasidambhorasatmakam Rupavat sparshavachchambho ghoshavachchatanvay at Visheshastuvikurvanadambhasogandhavanabhuh Paranvayadrasa sparsha rupa shabda gunanvitah Vaikarikan manojnye devavaikarika dashah Digvatarkaprachetoshvivanhindropendra mitrakah Taijasat tuvikuvanadindriyani dashabhavan Jnana shaktih kriya shaktirbuddhih pranastaijasau Shrotratvagghranadrugjihvavagdor medhranghripayavah Yaiyete sangatabhavabhutendriya manogunah Yadayatana nirmanenashhekur brahma vittamah Tada samhatyachanyonyam bhagavat shakti choditah Sadasatvamupadayano bhayam sasrujuhyathah Varshapuga sahasrante tadandamudakeshay am Kala karmasvabhavasthojivo jivamajijanat Saisha purushastasmadandan nirbhidy anirgatah Sahasrorvanghribahvakshis sahasranana shirshavan Yasyahavayavairlokan kalpayanti manishinah Urvadi bhiradhas sapta saptordhvanjaghanadibhih Purushasya mukham brahma kshatrametasya bahavah Urvorvaishyo bhagavat padbhyam shudrovyajayata Bhurlokah kalpitapadbhyam bhuvarlokosyanabhitah Hrudasvarloka urasa maharloko mahatmanah Grivayanjanalokashcha tapolokosya netrayoh Murdhabhis satyalokastubrahmalokas sanatanah Tatkatyamatalankruptamurubhyam vitalam vibho Janubhyam sutalam kruptanjanghabhyantutalatalam Mahatalantu gulphabhyam prapadabhyam rasatalam Patalam padatalata itilokamayapuman Bhurlokah kalpitapadbhyam bhuvarlokastunabhitah Svarlokah kalpitamurdhnitivavaloka kalpana Brahmovacha Vachovanhairmukham kshatram chandasam saptadhatavah Havyakavyamrutanananjihva sarvarasasyacha Sarvasunanchavayoshcha tannase paramayane Ashvinoroshadhinancha ghrano gandhasya chaivahi Rupanam tejasanchakshurdiyasuryasya chakshini Karnau dishancha tirthanam shrotramakasha shabdayoh Tadgatram vastusaranam saubhagyasya cha bhajanam Tvagasyasparsha vayoshcha sarvamedhasya chaivahi Romanyudbhijatinam yairvayajnyastu sambrutah Keshashmashrunyakshyasya shilalohabhradvidyutam Bahavoloka palanam prayashah kshema karmanam Vikramo bhurbhuvasvashcha kshemasya sharanasya cha Sarvakamavara syapi hareshcharana aspadam Apam viryasya sargasya parjanyasya prajapateh Pumsashishnupastas tu prajaty ananda nirvruteh Payuryamasyamitrasya parimokshasya narada Himsaya nirutermrutyornirasya gudas smrutah Parabhuteradharmasya tamasashchapi pashchimah Nadyonadanadinamtu gotranam asthi samhatihi Avyakta rasa sindhunam bhutanam nidhanasya cha Udaram viditam pumso hrudayam manasah padam Dharmasya mamatu bhyancha kumaranam bhavasya cha Vijnanasya cha tatvasya parasya atma parayanam Aham bhavan bhavashchaiva ya ime munayograja Surasura naranagah khagamruga sarisrupah Gandharvapsaraso yaksha rakshobhutaganoragah Pashavah pitarah siddha vidyadhara charana drumah Anyecha vividha jiva jalasthala nabhaukasah Graharkshaketavastaras taditas tanayitnavah Sarvam purusha evedam bhutam bhavyam bhavat yat Tenedamavrutam vishvam vitastimadhitishtata Svadhishnyam pratapan prano bahishcha pratapatyasau
